mentions.name: Grasp
mentions.description: Grasp is a new programming language that expands on the ideas of Lisp, reimagined as a graph processing language in the way Lisp is a list processing language. It is an early-stage project, with ideas documented in a Substack post.
mentions.source_excerpt: Its not far along, but I'm trying to expand upon the ideas of Lisp into a new programming language I call Grasp. If Lisp is a list processing language, Grasp is a graph processing language
